sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, HueHearts is a matching game where you need to match the top heart in a rectangular array with the color of the incoming flowers. The game starts with a 5x5 grid of hearts, and as you progress, the grid size increases. The incoming flowers are displayed at the top of the screen, and you need to move the hearts to match the color of the flowers.

The game's grid is made up of hearts, which come in six different colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. Each color has its own unique score, with the rarer colors scoring more points. As you match hearts, you'll earn points, and the game will display your current score at the top of the screen.

One of the unique features of HueHearts is the ability to move the hearts around using the arrow keys. This adds a layer of complexity to the game, making it more challenging and engaging. You can move a heart to the left, right, up, or down, and the game will automatically match the heart with the corresponding color of the incoming flowers.

The core gameplay mechanics of HueHearts are simple yet addictive. The game's simplicity makes it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels, while the challenge of finding the perfect match will keep you engaged for hours on end.
